plugin.name: Privileged Access
plugin.description: Ask for approval before anyone connects to a privileged host, with access that ends on its own and a full audit trail.

request.hoursHint: This host allows up to {{max}} hours.
request.sent: Request sent. You get an alert when someone decides.
request.noHostsHint: Hosts an admin marks as privileged show here.

list.endConfirm: End this access now? Open sessions on the host close.

request.title: Ask for privileged access
request.description: Ask for time limited access to privileged hosts.

approve.title: Approve privileged access
approve.description: Decide other people's access requests, end access early and read the report.

bypass.title: Break glass access
bypass.description: Connect to privileged hosts without a request. Every use is audited and alerted.

configure.title: Configure privileged hosts
configure.description: Mark hosts as privileged and change who approves access to them

pendingHours.label: Request lifetime (hours)
pendingHours.description: A request nobody decides in this time expires.

alertBypass.label: Alert on break glass access
alertBypass.description: Alert approvers when someone connects with break glass access.

enable.label: Privileged host
enable.description: SSH and remote desktop sessions to this host need approved access.

approverRoles.label: Approver roles
approverRoles.description: Role names, separated by commas, whose members may approve. Empty lets anyone with the approve permission decide.

maxHours.label: Longest access (hours)
maxHours.description: The most hours one request can ask for.

requireReason.label: Ask for a reason
requireReason.description: A request must say why access is needed.

requireTicket.label: Ask for a ticket
requireTicket.description: A request must name a ticket number.

allowBackground.label: Let background work through
allowBackground.description: Polling and other non interactive plugin connections skip the approval. Leave off to block every session without access.
